name: TPU v5 tensor core reverse engineering

mentions.name: TPU v5 tensor core reverse engineering
mentions.description: This project reverse engineers the tensor core on Google's TPU v5 and documents its instruction set. The work stems from the belief that Nvidia GPUs' architecture is a bit subpar for machine learning and that TPUs could be a viable alternative but remain rather undocumented.
mentions.problem: Nvidia GPUs' architecture is considered a bit subpar for machine learning, and TPUs could be a viable alternative but are still rather undocumented.
mentions.source_excerpt: We've been reverse engineering the tensor core on TPU v5: https://gherkinlabs.com/v5e-tensorcore-instructions
mentions.author: gherkinlabs
